title: Kolejka Serpost
description: Statyczny średnio-szeroki plan urzędu Serpost. Van stoi jako następny w kolejce z zapakowaną przesyłką, ściska ją i nerwowo zerka na wejście. Nie podchodzi jeszcze do okienka.

prompts.image: Cinematic medium-wide inside the referenced real SERPOST office in Iquitos. Exact Van Sabe stands next in a short ordinary queue, tightly holding a plain parcel containing the hidden K20. He is visibly frightened and scans the entrance while trying to look normal. Grounded fluorescent realism; background customers ignore him.
prompts.animation: One continuous 4-second shot. Static camera with a subtle slow push. The queue advances one place; Van tightens his grip on the parcel, glances sharply toward the entrance, then forces himself to face the counter. Background customers make small natural movements. Preserve exact identity, anatomy, wardrobe, parcel and post office. No Pipa, visible die, chase, morphing, cuts, captions, logos or watermark.
